name: raven-mcp
description: Design intelligence and creative orchestration for Claude — principles, patterns, audits, brand guidance, creative jobs, campaign plans, and local brand profiles.
long_description: Raven gives Claude a design knowledge base and creative orchestration layer it can query while generating UI and production briefs. Eight design layers cover principles (Nielsen, Laws of UX, Gestalt, WCAG, typography, color, mobile UX, D4D, UX writing, service design, brand), patterns (signup, pricing, nav, forms, landing, dashboard, modals, empty/error/loading states, CTAs, social proof, mobile conversion, plus content patterns and service patterns), content design systems (Mailchimp, GOV.UK, Shopify Polaris, Atlassian voice & tone), research methods (qualitative, quantitative, usability) and metrics frameworks (HEART, AARRR, North Star, conversion funnel, RICE, OKRs), service design (service blueprinting with HTML blueprint generation, human handoff, signup-as-service, omnichannel continuity, moments of truth / recovery, GOV.UK service standard), brand & visual design (logo usage, gradient usage, imagery, visual hierarchy, brand-as-system, current trends), business strategy, and production design tokens (Stripe, Linear, and more). The creative studio layer adds local brand profiles, asset references, character reference profiles, provider-agnostic image/video/3D/audio generation jobs, campaign plans, and transparent creative scoring. Claude calls Raven's tools automatically when you ask it to build, evaluate, improve UI, design research, design a service, or prepare creative production.

tools.name: get_principles
tools.description: Get design principles relevant to a UI context

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Get proven patterns for a specific UI type

tools.name: get_business_strategy
tools.description: Get business/monetization strategies

tools.name: evaluate_design
tools.description: Evaluate a design description against principles. Pass before_screenshot and after_screenshot (base64 PNGs) to get a structured pixel diff with fix_confirmed, changed_ratio, and changed_region.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search across all principles, patterns, and strategies

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: Get a pre-publish checklist for a UI type

tools.name: get_d4d_framework
tools.description: Get Design for Delight framework templates

tools.name: list_design_systems
tools.description: Browse available design systems

tools.name: get_design_system
tools.description: Get tokens for a specific design system

tools.name: read_design_md
tools.description: Parse a DESIGN.md file and return its tokens plus Markdown body

tools.name: init_design_md
tools.description: Initialize a DESIGN.md file from a stored system, starter slug, or blank template

tools.name: update_design_md
tools.description: Update one DESIGN.md token surgically while preserving the Markdown body

tools.name: start_grab_session
tools.description: Start the Raven grab bridge on loopback for a DESIGN.md path

tools.name: get_grabbed_elements
tools.description: Drain the Raven grab queue, optionally waiting for the next selection

tools.name: stop_grab_session
tools.description: Stop the Raven grab bridge and clear any queued selections

tools.name: compose_system
tools.description: Mix tokens from different systems

tools.name: get_brand_system
tools.description: Get a full design system styled like a well-known brand

tools.name: audit_page
tools.description: Audit HTML/CSS against Raven's design quality standards — pass html for static audit, or url to render the page headless with optional scroll_settle and viewport parameters (containerMaxWidth checks container widths against your design-system token). Set adversarial_verify to independently re-check findings against the live DOM, tagging each confirmed/likely-artifact/inconclusive with evidence.

tools.name: generate_design_system
tools.description: Generate a complete custom design system from a brand color

tools.name: audit_layout
tools.description: Evaluate visual rhythm, alignment, and optical balance of a rendered page

tools.name: audit_responsive_visibility
tools.description: Render a URL at multiple breakpoints and flag content elements that are visible on desktop but hidden on mobile

tools.name: audit_contrast
tools.description: Compute WCAG contrast ratios for every text element on a rendered page and report AA/AAA pass-fail

tools.name: audit_content
tools.description: Per-item content verdicts (pass/warn/fail) for headings, prose, CTAs, labels, captions, metrics against UX-writing principles + heuristics, with before→after suggestions

tools.name: audit_typography
tools.description: Typographic-scale report over rendered text nodes — modular-scale ratio detection + off-scale outliers, line-height consistency, and weight-ladder checks

tools.name: audit_tap_targets
tools.description: WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple 44pt web tap-target audit — per-element fix table with measured size, per-axis pixel deficit, and a concrete CSS fix

tools.name: audit_device_frame
tools.description: Flag cropped content in device-mockup frames: object-fit:cover crop loss (container AR vs media AR), baked-in pan/zoom (Ken Burns) from first/last clip frames, and content truncated at a frame edge

tools.name: list_content_systems
tools.description: Browse available brand voice & tone systems (Mailchimp, GOV.UK, Shopify Polaris, Atlassian)

tools.name: get_content_system
tools.description: Get a brand's content design system — voice, tone shifts, vocabulary, grammar, content patterns, inclusive language

tools.name: get_content_principles
tools.description: Get UX-writing principles — clarity, active voice, error-message anatomy, inclusive language, voice vs tone, and more

tools.name: get_content_pattern
tools.description: Get content design patterns — copy recipes for error messages, empty-state copy, notifications, and form validation

tools.name: get_research_method
tools.description: Get research method details — qualitative, quantitative, or usability — with protocols, do/don't guidance, and checklists

tools.name: get_metrics_framework
tools.description: Get a product-metrics framework — HEART, AARRR, North Star, conversion funnel, RICE, or OKRs

tools.name: get_service_pattern
tools.description: Get a service design pattern — service blueprinting, human handoff, signup-as-service, omnichannel continuity, or moments of truth / recovery

tools.name: get_service_standard
tools.description: Get the GOV.UK Service Standard — 14 points for assessing whether a service is ready to launch

tools.name: generate_service_blueprint
tools.description: Render a service blueprint as a self-contained HTML page — with optional current-vs-ideal state comparison

tools.name: get_brand_principles
tools.description: Get brand and visual-design principles — logo usage, gradient usage, imagery, visual hierarchy, brand-as-system

tools.name: get_brand_trends
tools.description: Get current brand and visual-design trends (2026) — bento grids, monospace type, neon-on-glass, generative patterns, brutalism rebound, and more

tools.name: list_creative_models
tools.description: Browse Raven creative model slots for image, video, 3D, audio, character consistency, and analysis

tools.name: list_creative_presets
tools.description: Browse creative presets for product photoshoots, marketplace cards, UGC ads, TV spots, social packs, storyboards, and infographics

tools.name: create_brand_profile
tools.description: Create or update a local brand profile for brand-aware creative generation jobs

tools.name: get_brand_profile

tools.name: list_brand_profiles
tools.description: List local Raven creative brand profiles

tools.name: register_creative_asset

tools.name: create_character_profile

tools.name: get_generation_job

tools.name: list_generation_jobs
tools.description: List local Raven creative generation jobs

tools.name: plan_creative_campaign

tools.name: score_creative

tools.name: raven_reflect
tools.description: Summarize your local Raven usage log — tool counts, recurring audit warnings, and likely knowledge gaps. Reads only the local log file; never fetches.

tools.name: raven_register
tools.description: Register to receive design updates and send feedback
